Subject: Draft private offer & proposed drawdown cadence

Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. The execs at Acme are aligned on the model choice and want to move forward with a GCP Private Offer. Before we spin up legal, two quick asks so we can land our internal procurement timeline: 

1) Can Redwood confirm a recommended commit drawdown cadence (monthly vs quarterly) for a 24-month private offer sized at $1.2M? Our finance team prefers predictable monthly drawdowns but procurement sometimes pushes quarterly for PO simplicity.

2) Who at Redwood will be the contracting/legal point of contact for redlines? We will send a mark to Contracts Ops but want to make sure the right person is looped.

Attached is our internal forecast and a blank PO template (just for reference).

Thanks —
Ben

Hi Ben —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the forecast. Short answers up front: monthly drawdown is supported and is typically what we recommend for predictability (helps with reserved capacity scheduling). We can also map to quarterly invoicing if Acme prefers PO alignment — the committed spend and billing terms are decoupled.

Rafael (sales lead) will coordinate the commercial terms and finalize the commit cadence. Monica (contracts) will be your counterparty for redlines. Lauren (partner motion) will work with Priya at Google to confirm co-sell eligibility and any marketplace credit timing.

I'll kick off a short internal checklist and propose a working session Friday to align on deadlines for PO, DocuSign, and GCP Private Offer submission. Proposed draft agenda:
- Confirm commit drawdown (monthly vs quarterly) & sample schedule
- Marketplace listing steps & required partner info for private offer creation
- Contract redline ownership and turnaround SLAs
- Co-sell/credits ramp and attribution timing

Ben — are you available Friday 10:00am PT for a 30-min sync? If not, suggest two alternatives.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Thanks for the background, Rafael. Short answers: co-sell credit attribution is agnostic to drawdown cadence — credits are tied to declared private offers and close dates, not per-invoice drawdown frequency. That said, two practical notes: 

- If you choose monthly drawdown, include a clear billing schedule in the private offer metadata so reconciliation teams can map invoice lines to the commit drawdown.
- For faster processing, provide the partner_id, reseller_id, and the exact contract term (24 months) in the initial private offer submission. We also recommend attaching the signed PO as a PDF at creation to avoid hold-ups.

I'll paste a short checklist below and attach the private-offer creation guide.

Google quick checklist (high level):
1) Partner ID (P-XXXXXX) and Partner Rep email
2) Customer Org ID & billing profile
3) Signed PO + redlines summary as one PDF
4) Commit amount, term, and drawdown schedule (monthly/quarterly)
5) Contact for finance reconciliation

Docs: https://cloud.google.com/marketplace/partners/private-offers (public guide)
Internal note: If Redwood wants expedited co-sell review, flag as "partner-recommended" in the submission and loop me — I'll chase reconciliation.

Priya Sinha
Partner Sales, Google Cloud

Team —

Thanks everyone for the quick inputs. Summary and next steps below (agreed plan):

1) Commit drawdown: Acme confirmed monthly drawdown. Redwood will provide a draft monthly schedule (attached commit_drawdown_schedule.xlsx) that maps invoices to calendar months for reconciliation.

2) Private offer creation: Acme will submit the private offer with partner_id (we will provide) and attach the signed PO. Priya, thanks — we'll include the partner-recommended flag to speed co-sell handling.

3) Legal & redlines: Monica will take lead on the contract redlines and circulate a single tracked changes doc to Contracts Ops by Tue 07/06. Expect one round of redlines + 48-hour turnaround from Acme.

4) Marketplace & co-sell: Lauren to confirm Marketplace listing metadata and confirm attribution settings. Rafael will track deal in HubSpot (deal id: RDW-GCP-2026-0134).

5) Timeline: target DocuSign signature by 07/14, private offer submission to GCP by 07/15, first drawdown invoice issued 08/01.

Ben — please confirm the PO filename you will upload (use the same PDF attached in the private offer). Also confirm Acme finance contact for reconciliation.

Attachments included: RDW_GCP_Private_Offer_Term_Summary_v1.pdf, commit_drawdown_schedule.xlsx, redlines_contract.docx
